timezone_policy: Use America/New_York via the installed timezone database, validated against the pinned dependency lock; local session times are converted per date, never a fixed UTC offset.
source_policy: Published NYSE 2027 cash-equity regular sessions only. Nasdaq and NasdaqTrader public year tables still cover 2026 at retrieval; this resource does not claim XNAS 2027 confirmation. Only November 26 closes early; July 2 and December 31 are regular sessions. Temporary closures and subsequent changes are not covered. Missing bars are rejected, never relabeled as holidays.
